steps.note: Imran alone at his bench: the player takes him in. HaX says the cost first, then he hands over a cloned card (no ghost watch on the route) and the supplier crate line plays. Re-talk is the quiet 'sit me somewhere warm'.

said: I saw the scribble. I thought it was somebody being clever.
Let him go and the phone goes with him. Keep him, and we get his supplier.
Card's on my belt. Take your copy.
A crate signed for at the service door on Tuesday.
notSaid: They told me to keep my card on me tonight.

said: I've given you everything. Sit me somewhere warm.
